title: Block-Transitive $5$-$(v,k,2)$ Designs with $k$ divides $v$
summary: The classification of block-transitive 5-designs remains an open problem. The additional parameter condition that $k$ divides $v$ is called the Camina-Gagen condition. In this paper, we investigate block-transitive simple $5$-$(v,k,2)$ designs satisfying the Camina-Gagen condition. Using the classification of finite $2$-homogeneous permutation groups, we consider the affine and almost simple cases separately.
